greet.text: A tall figure in black sits on a throne built of skulls, each one carved with a name. The Lord does not rise. 'Another small thing climbs my ridge. Speak before I decide what you are useful for.'

choices.label: Polish the throne and keep her cup full. (3 days)
Ask what Soul Formation took from her.
Ask what the Lord wants from the living.
Bring the Soul Severing Lotus Xuan asked for.

skulls.text: 'Every rival I outlived. I remember each name; that is why I carve them. The living forget and the dead are too polite to complain, but bone is honest.' The Lord taps the nearest. 'This one begged very well.'

serve.text: Half-lidded eyes watch you and say nothing for three days. On the last, a hand tips the cup toward you without looking, and the blood-dark wine burns pleasantly all the way down. Killing intent seeps into your meridians and, strangely, steadies them.

price.text: 'My name. The one my mother gave me. I cut it away to pass the threshold, and now I only answer to the one I took. Do not look so grave, little one. I would do it again. Anyone who says otherwise has never been afraid of dying.'

errand_ask.text: 'There is a black lotus that blooms where a death is still deciding to happen. I used to pick them myself. Now I am too well known; they wilt when I approach. Bring me one and I will give you what I took from a man who thought he could live forever.'

errand_thanks.text: The Lord cradles the lotus like a newborn, then crushes a single petal against a tongue. The smile is the most frightening thing you have seen all year. 'Good. Take this, and remember who gave it.' A Longevity Pill rolls across the floor of skulls toward you.
